definition: hidden speed = residual of c40_v_20_40 (tracked flying 20, official 20->40 yd lines) on the official forty within Combine WRs, both centered within draft year: speed beyond the official 40 time. rank = by observed hidden speed; rank_shrunk = by the measurement-error-shrunk value. top_quintile = observed hidden speed >= its 80th percentile; p_true_top_quintile = posterior probability that the true value is in the top quintile (attempt-to-attempt error only). Game targets are the E007 P1-P3 targets where available (null = not enough game data).
notes: Descriptive only. E007 found no game outcome that hidden speed predicts beyond B2 (cushion, yards per route, targets, depth of target, deep-route share, career snaps: null or negative), so neither a high rank nor top_quintile_and_late means 'undervalued'.
Draft position also reflects medical, character, off-field and other non-football factors. late_round_or_undrafted is not evidence that a player's athleticism was missed.

Hidden speed is noisy: reliability about 0.72; built from attempt 1 alone vs attempt 2 alone it correlates about 0.70, and about half of the top quintile changes. Players with one QC-passing attempt are the least certain. Error in the official forty is not included.
The tracked component beyond the 40 is not corroborated by the official electronic 10-yd split, and the 20-yd split that clubs receive is not in the data.
